title: Genesis 22:3 — Abraham rose early and set out with Isaac
summary: Genesis 22:3 under the heading “The Akedah”: Abraham rises early, saddles his donkey, takes two young men and his son Isaac, splits wood for the burnt offering and goes to the place God told him of.

text.text: 3 So Abraham rose early in the morning and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him and Isaac his son; and he split wood for the burnt offering, and arose and went to the place of which God had told him.

numbers.note: two young men taken along (highlighted in green)
